select 
balances.balanceable_type,
count(distinct balances.user_id) as user_count,
count(distinct balances.id) as amount_count,
sum(abs(balances.amount)) as amount_rial

from users 

inner join balances on balances.user_id = users.id
and balances.deleted_at is null 
and (balances.created_at)>= '2026-03-24 00:00:00'
and (balances.created_at)<= '2026-03-26 00:00:00'
and (
balances.balanceable_type like '%%ProviderPriceSuggestion%%' or
balances.balanceable_type like '%%GatewayTransaction%%'
)
where
users.userable_type like '%%Provider%%' and 
users.mobile in (
